responses.summary: 12 V Wi-Fi motor/relay controller with an INA226 motor-current monitor.
functional_goals: drive one brushed DC motor up to 0.5 A in both directions
switch one 5 V relay with contacts on a screw terminal
protect the 12 V input against reverse polarity, overcurrent and surges
UART programming header, status LED, four M3 mounting holes
measure motor supply current and power with an INA226

power_sources.notes: 12 V 1 A wall adapter, centre positive

assumptions.text: Relay contacts switch low-voltage loads only (<= 30 V DC)
Motor runs from the protected 12 V rail
50 mOhm shunt: 25 mV at 0.5 A, well inside the INA226 81.92 mV range

open_questions: Motor stall current (sets the driver current limit)?
out_of_scope: switching mains voltage through the relay contacts

sensors.notes: high-side shunt on the motor supply
